style: Premium high-definition pixel art, readable top-down action RPG sprites, distinct upgrade tiers
notes: Transparent RGBA PNGs are used for characters, objects, weapons, effects, and UI overlays.
World tiles intentionally fill the full canvas for seamless map rendering.
Weapon and passive tier variants use visibly stronger silhouette, color, glow, and ornamentation per tier.

playerWalkStandard.cropPolicy: Each source cell is isolated, background-flood removed, scaled into 80x80, horizontally centered, and feet-aligned to a common y=75 baseline.
